items.source: Spring Boot has no mandatory logging dependency, except for the Commons Logging API, which is typically provided by Spring Framework’s spring-jcl module. To use Logback, you need to include it and spring-jcl on the classpath. The recommended way to do that is through the starters, which all depend on spring-boot-starter-logging. For a web application, you only need spring-boot-starter-web, since it depends transitively on the logging starter. If you use Maven, the following dependency adds logging for you:
items.translation: Spring Boot 没有强制的日志依赖，除了 Commons Logging API，它通常由 Spring Framework 的 `spring-jcl` 模块提供。 若要使用 Logback，您需要将其和 `spring-jcl` 添加到类路径中。 推荐的方式是通过 starter 来实现，它们都依赖于 `spring-boot-starter-logging`。 对于 Web 应用程序，您只需要 `spring-boot-starter-web`，因为它通过传递依赖包含了日志 starter。 如果您使用 Maven，以下依赖会自动为您添加日志功能：

items.source: file-appender.xml - Adds a RollingFileAppender using the FILE_LOG_PATTERN and ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN with appropriate settings.
items.translation: file-appender.xml - 使用 FILE_LOG_PATTERN 和 ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN 以及适当的设置添加一个 RollingFileAppender。

items.source: structured-file-appender.xml - Adds a RollingFileAppender using the ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN with structured logging in the FILE_LOG_STRUCTURED_FORMAT.
items.translation: structured-file-appender.xml - 使用 ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN 在 FILE_LOG_STRUCTURED_FORMAT 中通过结构化日志添加一个 RollingFileAppender。

items.source: To configure the more fine-grained settings of a logging system, you need to use the native configuration format supported by the LoggingSystem in question. By default, Spring Boot picks up the native configuration from its default location for the system (such as classpath:logback.xml for Logback), but you can set the location of the config file by using the logging.config property.
items.translation: 要配置日志系统的更细粒度设置，您需要使用相关 LoggingSystem 支持的本地配置格式。默认情况下，Spring Boot 会从系统的默认位置（例如 Logback 的 classpath:logback.xml）加载本地配置，但您可以通过使用 logging.config 属性来设置配置文件的位置。

items.source: If you need to apply customizations to logback beyond those that can be achieved with application.properties, you will need to add a standard logback configuration file. You can add a logback.xml file to the root of your classpath for logback to find. You can also use logback-spring.xml if you want to use the Spring Boot Logback Extensions.
items.translation: 如果需要对 logback 进行无法通过 application.properties` 实现的自定义，您需要添加一个标准的 logback 配置文件。 您可以将 `logback.xml` 文件添加到类路径的根目录中，以便 logback 查找。 如果您想使用 Spring Boot Logback Extensions，也可以使用 `logback-spring.xml。

items.source: console-appender.xml - Adds a ConsoleAppender using the CONSOLE_LOG_PATTERN.
items.translation: console-appender.xml - 使用 CONSOLE_LOG_PATTERN 添加一个 ConsoleAppender。

items.source: structured-console-appender.xml - Adds a ConsoleAppender using structured logging in the CONSOLE_LOG_STRUCTURED_FORMAT.
items.translation: structured-console-appender.xml - 使用结构化日志在 CONSOLE_LOG_STRUCTURED_FORMAT 中添加一个 ConsoleAppender。

items.source: If you want to disable console logging and write output only to a file, you need a custom logback-spring.xml that imports file-appender.xml but not console-appender.xml, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 如果您想禁用控制台日志并将输出仅写入文件，您需要一个自定义的 `logback-spring.xml` 来导入 `file-appender.xml` 但不导入 `console-appender.xml`，如下例所示：

items.source: You also need to add logging.file.name to your application.properties or application.yaml, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 您还需要在 `application.properties` 或 `application.yaml` 中添加 logging.file.name，如下例所示：

items.source: Log4j 2 has support for combining multiple configuration files into a single composite configuration. To use this support in Spring Boot, configure logging.log4j2.config.override with the locations of one or more secondary configuration files. The secondary configuration files will be merged with the primary configuration, whether the primary’s source is Spring Boot’s defaults, a standard location such as log4j.xml, or the location configured by the logging.config property.
items.translation: Log4j 2 支持将多个配置文件合并为单个组合配置。要在 Spring Boot 中使用此功能，请配置 logging.log4j2.config.override` 以指定一个或多个次要配置文件的位置。无论主配置的来源是 Spring Boot 的默认值、标准位置（如 `log4j.xml`）还是由 `logging.config 属性配置的位置，这些次要配置文件都会与主配置合并。

items.source: Log4j2 override configuration file locations can be prefixed with optional:. For example, optional:classpath:log4j2-override.xml indicates that log4j2-override.xml should only be loaded if the resource exists.
items.translation: Log4j2 覆盖配置文件位置可以以 optional:` 作为前缀。例如，`optional:classpath:log4j2-override.xml` 表示仅当资源存在时才加载 `log4j2-override.xml。

items.source: Spring Boot has a LoggingSystem abstraction that attempts to configure logging based on the content of the classpath. If Logback is available, it is the first choice.
items.translation: Spring Boot 具有一个 LoggingSystem 抽象层，该抽象层尝试根据类路径的内容配置日志记录。如果 Logback 可用，则将其作为首选。

items.source: Your logback configuration file can also make use of System properties that the LoggingSystem takes care of creating for you:
items.translation: 您的 logback 配置文件也可以使用由 LoggingSystem 为您创建的 System properties：

items.source: ${LOG_FILE}: Whether logging.file.name was set in Boot’s external configuration.
items.translation: ${LOG_FILE}：Boot 的外部配置中是否设置了 `logging.file.name`。

items.source: ${LOG_PATH}: Whether logging.file.path (representing a directory for log files to live in) was set in Boot’s external configuration.
items.translation: ${LOG_PATH}：Boot 的外部配置中是否设置了 `logging.file.path`（表示日志文件存储目录）。

items.source: ${LOG_EXCEPTION_CONVERSION_WORD}: Whether logging.exception-conversion-word was set in Boot’s external configuration.
items.translation: ${LOG_EXCEPTION_CONVERSION_WORD}：Boot 的外部配置中是否设置了 `logging.exception-conversion-word`。

items.source: ${ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN}: Whether logging.pattern.rolling-file-name was set in Boot’s external configuration.
items.translation: ${ROLLING_FILE_NAME_PATTERN}：Boot 的外部配置中是否设置了 `logging.pattern.rolling-file-name`。

items.source: Spring Boot also provides some nice ANSI color terminal output on a console (but not in a log file) by using a custom Logback converter. See the CONSOLE_LOG_PATTERN in the defaults.xml configuration for an example.
items.translation: Spring Boot 还通过自定义 Logback 转换器，在控制台（但不在日志文件中）提供了一些不错的 ANSI 颜色终端输出。有关示例，请查看defaults.xml配置中的CONSOLE_LOG_PATTERN。

items.source: Spring Boot supports Log4j 2 for logging configuration if it is on the classpath. If you use the starters for assembling dependencies, you have to exclude Logback and then include Log4j 2 instead. If you do not use the starters, you need to provide (at least) spring-jcl in addition to Log4j 2.
items.translation: Spring Boot 支持在类路径中包含 Log4j 2 时用于日志配置。如果您使用启动器来组装依赖项，则必须排除 Logback，然后改用 Log4j 2。如果您不使用启动器，则需要额外提供（至少）`spring-jcl` 以及 Log4j 2。

items.source: If the only change you need to make to logging is to set the levels of various loggers, you can do so in application.properties by using the "logging.level" prefix, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 如果只需对日志进行更改以设置各种记录器的级别，则可以在 application.properties 中使用 "logging.level" 前缀来执行此操作，如下面的示例所示：

items.source: You can also set the location of a file to which the log will be written (in addition to the console) by using logging.file.name.
items.translation: 您也可以使用 logging.file.name 设置日志写入的文件位置（除控制台外）。

items.source: Spring Boot provides a number of logback configurations that can be included in your own configuration. These includes are designed to allow certain common Spring Boot conventions to be re-applied.
items.translation: Spring Boot 提供了一些可以在您的配置中include的 logback 配置。这些 include 旨在允许重新应用某些常见的 Spring Boot 约定。

items.source: The following files are provided under org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/:
items.translation: 以下文件提供在org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/下：

items.source: defaults.xml - Provides conversion rules, pattern properties and common logger configurations.
items.translation: defaults.xml - 提供转换规则、模式属性和通用日志记录配置。

items.source: In addition, a legacy base.xml file is provided for compatibility with earlier versions of Spring Boot.
items.translation: 此外，提供了一个遗留的base.xml文件，以兼容早期版本的 Spring Boot。

items.source: A typical custom logback.xml file would look something like this:
items.translation: 一个典型的自定义 logback.xml 文件大致如下所示：

items.source: ${PID}: The current process ID.
items.translation: ${PID}：当前进程 ID。

items.source: If Groovy is on the classpath, you should be able to configure Logback with logback.groovy as well. If present, this setting is given preference.
items.translation: 如果类路径中包含 Groovy，您也应该能够使用 logback.groovy 来配置 Logback。如果存在此设置，将优先采用该设置。

items.source: Gradle provides a few different ways to set up the starters. One way is to use a module replacement. To do so, declare a dependency on the Log4j 2 starter and tell Gradle that any occurrences of the default logging starter should be replaced by the Log4j 2 starter, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: Gradle 提供了几种不同的方式来配置启动器。一种方法是使用模块替换。为此，声明对 Log4j 2 启动器的依赖，并告知 Gradle 应将任何默认日志启动器的出现替换为 Log4j 2 启动器，如下例所示：

items.source:
The recommended path is through the starters, even though it requires some jiggling.
The following example shows how to set up the starters in Maven:
items.translation: 推荐的路径是通过启动器（starters），尽管这需要一些调整。以下示例展示了如何在 Maven 中配置启动器：

items.source:
In addition to its default XML configuration format, Log4j 2 also supports YAML and JSON configuration files.
To configure Log4j 2 to use an alternative configuration file format, add the appropriate dependencies to the classpath and name your configuration files to match your chosen file format, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 除了默认的 XML 配置格式外，Log4j 2 还支持 YAML 和 JSON 配置文件。若要配置 Log4j 2 使用替代的配置文件格式，请将相应的依赖添加到类路径中，并将配置文件命名为您所选的文件格式，如下例所示：
